Version: 6.3.1
IP: 192.120.45.67
API name: get information of an interface
Parameter_fabricName: Network1
Parameter_nodeId: 12
Parameter_podId: 10
Parameter_interfaceType: Ethernet
Parameter_infoType: Speed

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Send a GET request to retrieve specified information for an interface from a network telemetry API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL endpoint to send the GET request to. This should include the base path without query parameters, e.g., 'https://{ip}/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo'.

params.description: The query parameters for the request.

fabricName.description: The name of the fabric to limit nodes pertaining to.

nodeId.description: The node identifier to limit results pertaining to.

podId.description: The pod identifier to limit results pertaining to.

interfaceType.description: The type of the interface to limit results pertaining to.

infoType.description: The type of information requested for the interface.

message.content:
Below is a **step‑by‑step guide** for building and sending a RESTful GET request to the Cisco Nexus Dashboard (ND) API that retrieves the *Speed* information for a specific interface.

> **API version** – 6.3.1  
> **Base URL** – `https://<ND‑IP>/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo`  
> **Endpoint** – `/interfaceInfo`  
> **HTTP method** – `GET`

---

## 1.  Build the URL with query parameters

| Parameter | Value | Notes |
|-----------|-------|-------|
| `fabricName` | `Network1` | Name of the fabric |
| `nodeId` | `12` | Node identifier |
| `podId` | `10` | Pod identifier |
| `interfaceType` | `ethernet` | Must match one of the allowed enum values (`gigabitethernet`, `fastethernet`, `ethernet`, `serial`) |
| `infoType` | `Speed` | Type of information requested |

**Full URL**

```
https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo?fabricName=Network1&nodeId=12&podId=10&interfaceType=ethernet&infoType=Speed
```

> **Tip:** URL‑encode the values if they contain special characters (not needed here).

---

## 2.  Authentication

ND uses **Basic Auth** or **Bearer Token**.  
Choose one:

| Method | Header |
|--------|--------|
| Basic Auth | `Authorization: Basic <base64(username:password)>` |
| Bearer Token | `Authorization: Bearer <token>` |

> **Example (Basic Auth)**  
> ```bash
> curl -k -u admin:admin123 \
>   "https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo?fabricName=Network1&nodeId=12&podId=10&interfaceType=ethernet&infoType=Speed"
> ```

> **Example (Bearer Token)**  
> ```bash
> curl -k -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..." \
>   "https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo?fabricName=Network1&nodeId=12&podId=10&interfaceType=ethernet&infoType=Speed"
> ```

> `-k` tells `curl` to skip certificate verification (use only in test environments).

---

## 3.  Using Postman (GUI)

1. **New Request** → `GET`  
2. **URL** → paste the full URL above  
3. **Headers** → add `Authorization` header as shown  
4. **Send** → view the JSON response in the “Body” tab

---

## 4.  Using Python (`requests`) – Example

```python
import requests
from requests.auth import HTTPBasicAuth

url = "https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo"
params = {
    "fabricName": "Network1",
    "nodeId": 12,
    "podId": 10,
    "interfaceType": "ethernet",
    "infoType": "Speed"
}

# Basic Auth
response = requests.get(url, params=params, auth=HTTPBasicAuth('admin', 'admin123'), verify=False)

print(response.status_code)
print(response.json())
```

> Replace `'admin'` / `'admin123'` with your credentials or switch to a bearer token by adding `headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer <token>'}`.

---

## 5.  Expected JSON Response (sample)

```json
{
  "fabricName": "Network1",
  "nodeId": 12,
  "podId": 10,
  "interfaceType": "ethernet",
  "infoType": "Speed",
  "speedMbps": 1000,
  "status": "up"
}
```

> The actual keys may differ; consult the ND API docs for the exact schema.

---

## 6.  Common Pitfalls & Troubleshooting

| Issue | Fix |
|-------|-----|
| **404 Not Found** | Verify the base URL and endpoint path (`/interfaceInfo`). |
| **401 Unauthorized** | Check credentials or token; ensure the account has the required role. |
| **400 Bad Request** | Ensure all query parameters are present and correctly typed (e.g., `interfaceType=ethernet`). |
| **SSL errors** | Use `-k` in `curl` or `verify=False` in `requests` for self‑signed certs (not recommended for production). |

---

### Quick Reference (curl)

```bash
curl -k -u admin:admin123 \
"https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo?fabricName=Network1&nodeId=12&podId=10&interfaceType=ethernet&infoType=Speed"
```

That’s it! You now have a fully‑formed RESTful GET request to fetch the speed of an Ethernet interface on Cisco Nexus Dashboard. Happy querying!
